name: Clustered Lighting + GI
author: Twilit Realm
description: Gathers every light in the scene (torches, lanterns, spotlights, effect lights) and shades them with clustered deferred lighting on the GPU, with optional global illumination: screen-space GI or voxel cone tracing. Can suppress the game's native 8-light dynamic lighting so the deferred pass owns all dynamic lights.
